scene.setting: A surreal, fantasy cosmic landscape under a deep space sky.
scene.lighting: Ethereal and magical, with glows originating from the cosmic book and the river, mixing with distant nebulae light.
scene.colors: Rich blues, purples, golds, vibrant orange/pinks, and crystalline greens.

book.appearance: A colossal, ancient, golden-bound book, wide open.
book.content: The pages are made of glowing constellations and swirling galaxies.
book.action: A radiant waterfall of starlight pours directly from the spine and pages into a river below.

scribe.appearance: An elderly, bearded figure (scholar or monk) in flowing robes.
scribe.action: Sitting and writing with a quill that emits magical sparks into a small notebook.
scribe.perch: Seated on a stylized, complex astrolabe or mechanical orbital device.

environment_details.river: A winding river flowing through a canyon, made of two parallel streams: liquid gold and vibrant cosmic blue.
environment_details.landscape: A rocky canyon with prominent, large, iridescent crystal formations.
environment_details.sky: A detailed cosmos with a large spiral galaxy, distant planets, and a bright moon.
environment_details.horizon: A bright, warm orange/pink celestial sunrise/sunset opposite the cosmic waterfall.

style.genre: High-fantasy concept art; epic digital painting.
style.technique: Highly detailed with rich texture, dramatic lighting, and a vibrant, illustrative finish.
